requests.name: act_apply_white_sunscreen
requests.why: 피부_30 설명 2칸('보통 선크림은 투명해서 이 빛이 거의 그대로 통과해요', 17.0~20.3초) + 피부_28 설명 4칸('밤에 바르는 건 … 햇빛에 예민해지기 때문 … 아침엔 자외선차단제', 26.6~33.8초) 왼쪽 공용. 흰 선크림을 광대에 점점이 찍어 펴 바르면 투명한 막이 되고, 그 밑 호박색은 그대로 비친다(30 = 투명해서 통과, 28 = 바르는 장면 — 꺼지게 그리지 않아 두 칸 다 맞다). 3칸 베이지 선크림(꺼짐)과 크림 색·결말이 갈린다. act_apply_face_cream은 avoid '침샘 점등, 피부엔 쓰지 말 것'. 펴 바르기가 의미라 Flow, 4초(30 3.3초 → 0.82배, 28 7.2초 → 1.8배). 화풍: 반투명 엑스레이 캐논(2026-10-06 사용자 결정 — 'AI영상인데 사람을 넣는다는 게 반감', 실사 _real 폐기). 크림 불투명 흰색, 튜브 무지. (2026-10-06 미드저니가 '얼굴에 묻은 흰 크림' 장면을 검열로 막아 흰·불투명 크림 표현을 뺐다.) (2026-10-06 사용자 '얼굴 포커스 들어가는 거 존나 징그러운데 안 볼 듯' — 얼굴 칸은 가슴 위 거리에 카메라 고정, 피부 속으로 파고드는 건 얼굴 없는 기전 클립에서만.)

requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts. The only thing that ever glows amber is one small soft patch in the thin layer just under the skin high on the right cheekbone, beneath the clear sunscreen — the eyes, the teeth, the jaw, the glands under the jaw, the neck and every organ in the chest stay soft pale cyan from the first frame to the last. 0-1.5s: from the very first frame the small patch under the cheekbone skin glows soft amber, and two fingertips keep spreading the clear sunscreen across the cheekbone in quick short strokes, back and forth three times, while the camera stays locked at the same chest-up framing. 1.5-3s: the sunscreen settles into a sheer, perfectly clear film that sits on the surface of the skin. 3-4s: the hand lifts away and the camera stays locked at the same chest-up framing; the amber patch shows straight through the sheer clear film, just as bright as before, glowing until the very last frame. Even close in, the glowing skin surface stays the brightest thing in the frame while the skull and teeth inside stay faint and soft. The body stays translucent glass with the bones and organs visible inside throughout; the face stays smooth and featureless. The dark slate blue-grey void stays empty. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame. Low synth hum with a soft slick sound of cream spreading, no music, no dialogue. The camera never pushes in, zooms or moves closer than the chest-up framing of the first frame; the face stays small in the frame so the skull, teeth and eye sockets inside the glass head stay faint and barely noticeable, and only the soft amber glow on the cheek draws the eye. The amber glow sits low on the cheek, well below the eye; the eyes and the area around the eyes never light up.
